校企协同赋能航天创新！天津大学党委书记杨贤金带队调研云遥宇航
为深化产学研融合、推进校企协同发展，6月8日，天津大学党委书记杨贤金带队莅临云遥宇航调研指导。云遥宇航创始人、天津大学校友李峰辉热情接待调研团队，详细介绍企业发展情况，双方围绕创新创业、人才培养、科研合作等核心议题展开深

为深化产学研融合、推进校企协同发展，6月8日，天津大学党委书记杨贤金带队莅临云遥宇航调研指导。云遥宇航创始人、天津大学校友李峰辉热情接待调研团队，详细介绍企业发展情况，双方围绕创新创业、人才培养、科研合作等核心议题展开深度座谈交流，共绘产学研融合发展新蓝图。

![](/media/news/ppdtImg46_260702133415A324.webp)

作为从天津大学走出去的科创企业，云遥宇航与母校渊源深厚，不仅是首届“北洋海棠杯”校友创新创业大赛特等奖获得者，也是北洋海棠基金对外投资的第一家公司。双方共建“海洋遥感技术联合实验室”，在气象海洋数据处理等领域已开展深度合作，成效显著。调研期间，李峰辉陪同杨贤金书记一行参观企业展厅，详细汇报了企业发展历程、核心技术优势及未来战略布局。自公司成立以来，云遥宇航深耕商业气象卫星全产业链，专注卫星载荷研发、整星制造，数据采集处理及行业应用落地，持续布局全球商业气象探测网络。

目前，公司已成功发射47颗自主研发商业气象卫星，稳步推进星座组网计划，核心技术与产品达到行业先进水平，广泛应用于气象探测、防灾减灾、航空航海、新能源电力交易等重点领域，凭借硬核科研实力与创新成果，成为天津商业航天科创标杆企业。

![](/media/news/ppdtImg48_260702133441A325.webp)

座谈交流中，杨贤金书记对云遥宇航的快速发展和创新成果给予高度肯定。他表示，云遥宇航是天津大学创新创业体系培育出的优秀校友企业，李峰辉校友怀揣航天初心、深耕科创领域，敢闯敢创、潜心攻坚的奋斗姿态，充分展现了天大人“实事求是、敢为人先”的精神风貌，为在校学子创新创业树立了典范。

杨贤金书记指出，天津大学始终坚持创新驱动发展这一目标，以服务国家重大战略需求为导向，全力推动科技成果转化与创新人才培养。他希望双方以此次调研为契机，进一步深化全方位、多层次校企合作，聚焦商业航天前沿领域，深化关键技术联合攻关，搭建优质实习实践平台，推动高校科研成果落地转化，企业产业资源反哺育人，实现校企双向赋能、互利共赢。

李峰辉对母校长期以来的培养与关注表示衷心感谢。他表示，云遥宇航的成长壮大，离不开母校的支持与赋能，“天津大学一号”卫星的成功发射，更是校企合作的标志性成果。未来，公司将持续深耕商业气象航天赛道，坚守技术自主创新道路，同时积极践行校友企业责任，主动深化与天大的校企协同，促进校企产学研深度融合，共同助力国家商业航天产业高质量发展与科技自立自强。

![](/media/news/ppdtImg49_260702133508A326.webp)

此次调研交流，进一步夯实了双方的合作基础、凝聚了发展共识。未来，云遥宇航将与天津大学携手同行，依托校企协同优势，以创新赋能航天事业，以匠心深耕科创赛道，在星辰大海的征程中续写校企合作崭新篇章。
Collaboration between universities and enterprises empowers aerospace innovation! The Party Secretary of Tianjin University, Yang Xianjin, leads a team to conduct a survey of Yunyao Aerospace.
To deepen the integration of industry-university-research and promote the collaborative development between universities and enterprises, on June 8th, the Party Secretary of Tianji

To deepen the integration of industry-university-research and promote the collaborative development between universities and enterprises, on June 8th, the Party Secretary of Tianjin University, Yang Xianjin, led a delegation to visit and guide Yunyao Aerospace. The founder of Yunyao Aerospace and a graduate of Tianjin University, Li Fenghui, warmly received the visiting team and detailed the development situation of the enterprise. Both sides engaged in in-depth discussions and exchanges on core issues such as innovation and entrepreneurship, talent cultivation, and scientific research cooperation, jointly drawing a new blueprint for the integrated development of industry-university-research.

![](/media/news/ppdtImg46_260702133617A327.webp)

As a scientific and technological enterprise that emerged from Tianjin University, Yunyao Aerospace has a deep connection with its alma mater. Not only did it win the first prize in the "Beiyang Huaotan Cup" Alumni Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition, but it was also the first company invested by the Beiyang Huaotan Fund. The two sides jointly established the "Joint Laboratory for Marine Remote Sensing Technology", and have carried out in-depth cooperation in areas such as meteorological and marine data processing, achieving remarkable results. During the research visit, Li Fenghui accompanied Secretary Yang Xianjin and his delegation to visit the company's exhibition hall and gave a detailed report on the company's development history, core technical advantages, and future strategic layout. Since its establishment, Yunyao Aerospace has focused on the entire commercial meteorological satellite industry chain, concentrating on the research and development of satellite payloads, the manufacturing of complete satellites, data collection and processing, and the implementation of industry applications. It has continuously laid out a global commercial meteorological observation network. 

At present, the company has successfully launched 47 independently developed commercial meteorological satellites, steadily advancing the constellation networking plan. Its core technologies and products have reached the advanced level in the industry, and are widely applied in key fields such as meteorological observation, disaster prevention and mitigation, aviation and navigation, and new energy power trading. With its strong scientific research capabilities and innovative achievements, it has become a benchmark enterprise for commercial aerospace innovation in Tianjin.

![](/media/news/ppdtImg48_260702133655A328.webp)

During the discussion and exchange, Secretary Yang Xianjin highly praised the rapid development and innovative achievements of Yunyao Aerospace. He stated that Yunyao Aerospace is an outstanding alumni enterprise cultivated by the innovation and entrepreneurship system of Tianjin University. Alumni Li Fenghui, with a strong passion for aerospace, has been deeply engaged in the field of scientific and technological innovation. His bold and pioneering spirit, as well as his dedication to tackling challenges, fully demonstrates the "pragmatism and pioneering spirit" of the students of Tianjin University, setting a model for the innovation and entrepreneurship of current students. 

Secretary Yang Xianjin pointed out that Tianjin University has always been committed to the goal of innovation-driven development, with the aim of serving the country's major strategic needs. It has been fully promoting the transformation of scientific and technological achievements and the cultivation of innovative talents. He hopes that both parties can take this research visit as an opportunity to further deepen all-round and multi-level university-enterprise cooperation, focus on the cutting-edge fields of commercial aerospace, deepen joint research on key technologies, build high-quality internship and practice platforms, promote the implementation and transformation of university research results, and enable enterprises to provide resources for education and training, achieving mutual empowerment and mutual benefit between the university and the enterprise. 

Li Fenghui expressed his heartfelt gratitude to his alma mater for its long-term nurturing and attention. He stated that the growth and expansion of Yunyao Aerospace would not have been possible without the support and empowerment from his school. The successful launch of the "Tianjin University No.1" satellite was a landmark achievement of the school-enterprise cooperation. In the future, the company will continue to deeply focus on the commercial meteorological aerospace field, adhere to the path of independent technological innovation, actively fulfill the responsibility of alumni enterprises, proactively deepen the school-enterprise collaboration with Tianjin University, promote the deep integration of school-enterprise research, production, and education, and jointly contribute to the high-quality development of the national commercial aerospace industry and the self-reliance and strength in science and technology.

![](/media/news/ppdtImg49_260702133754A329.webp)

This round of research and exchange has further strengthened the cooperation foundation between the two parties and consolidated the development consensus. In the future, Yunyao Aerospace will join hands with Tianjin University and leverage the synergy of university and enterprise collaboration. With innovation as the driving force for the aerospace industry and with meticulous dedication to the scientific and technological innovation field, they will continue to write a new chapter of university-enterprise cooperation on the journey of exploring the stars and the vast sea.
